data.name: Asah
data.gender_notes: Asah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who rises early or appears at dawn. Derived from the Arabic word ‘asaha’, meaning ‘to rise early’. This name is also found in Swedish culture and is believed to bring happiness and joy. The name Asah carries the meaning “Rising, Dawn” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Swedish. Parents who choose Asah usually hope their child will grow to embody rising, dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and renewal.
data.etymology: Asah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rising, Dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أساح
in_arabic.meaning: الأساح اسم يعني التسهيل والتيسير في الأمور والمسائل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأساح هو اسم مشتق من الفعل أساح والذي يعني التسهيل والتيسير في الأمور والمسائل، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن التيسير على الناس في أمورهم، مما يجعله ذا دلالة عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: اساح
in_urdu.meaning: اساح نام کا مطلب ہے مسائل و امور میں آسانی اور سہولت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اساح نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'أساح' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مسائل و امور میں آسانی اور سہولت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کا استعمال روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام اللہ کی طرف سے دی گئی آسانی اور سہولت کی یاد دلاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आसाह
in_hindi.meaning: आसाह नाम का अर्थ है मामलों और मुद्दों में आसानी और सुविधा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसाह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'أساح' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मामलों और मुद्दों में आसानी और सुविधा। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह नाम अल्लाह की ओर से दी गई आसानी और सुविधा की याद दिलाता है

in_pashto.name: اساح
in_pashto.meaning: اساح د نوم مطلب دی په چارو او مسايلو کې آسانۍ او سهولت
in_pashto.long_meaning: اساح د نوم عربي ژبې د کلمې 'أساح' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې مطلب يې په چارو او مسايلو کې آسانۍ او سهولت دی. په افغان او پښتني دود کې دا نوم د الهي آسانۍ او رحمې د يادګار په توګه کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Asah
in_english.meaning: Asah means facilitation and ease in matters and issues
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asah is derived from the Arabic root 'أساح', which signifies facilitation and ease in matters and issues. Referenced in the Quran, this name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing Allah's mercy and facilitation in human affairs. Historically, it has been used across Muslim cultures, reflecting a universal aspiration for ease and guidance

data.cultural_impact: The name “Asah” is of Arabic origin and is derived from the verb 'asaha,' which means 'to rise early.' It's a name that carries cultural significance in the Islamic world, where waking up early for prayer and reflecting on the divine is considered virtuous. Starting your day with the remembrance of God is a cherished practice, fostering a deep connection between the individual and their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name “Asah” can be traced back to the Islamic tradition where it represents one who is diligent in their spiritual practices and is always striving to seek knowledge and guidance from the Divine. The name is a reminder to rise above worldly distractions and focus on the eternal, spiritual journey, making it a profound and inspiring name with a powerful connection to spiritual growth. Embracing this name can serve as a daily reminder for individuals to live their lives with intention, compassion, and a deep connection to their faith.

historical_references.reference: Asah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
historical_references.context: Asah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim as a man from the Ansar (helpers) of Medina who pledged allegiance to the Prophet (pbuh) and participated in various battles.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Asah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Layla Asah, a teacher in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, shares that their name Asah meaning "Rising, Dawn" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
